title: Close-up of connected green circuit boards
visual_facts: Several green printed circuit boards overlap at an angle, with dense traces and surface-mounted components.
Two prominent square black integrated circuits sit on separate boards.
White multi-pin connectors along the upper board edges hold pale ribbon wires with red markings.
A small blue-and-white rectangular module is attached by wires at the lower left.
spatial_relations: The two main boards overlap diagonally in the center.
Ribbon wires arc upward from connectors on the boards.
The small blue module sits to the lower left of the boards.
uncertainties: The board labels are only partly legible; the circuit functions and exact board models cannot be confirmed.
